label: USDJPY Asia range breakout into London (Wednesday longs)
researchSummary: Tests whether a defined session range break continues or should be faded. Filtered by signalWeekdaySide=2_long. True bracket exit uses 2.5:1 reward/risk; forward PF was recomputed from actual stop/target/time exits.
